title: accounting-mcp
description: 8 EU accounting (x402 USDC on Base): reconcile, VAT, invoicing. Free health.
summary: 8 EU accounting (x402 USDC on Base): reconcile, VAT, invoicing. Free health.
offersHint: 8 EU accounting (x402 USDC on Base): reconcile, VAT, invoicing. Free health. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://xero.api.ainode.tech/mcp

toolsPreview.name: health
toolsPreview.description: Health check. Returns server status and optional echo.

toolsPreview.name: reconcile_transactions
toolsPreview.description: Match bank statement lines against unreconciled Xero transactions. Returns confidence-scored matches (>=0.8 matched, 0.5-0.8 suggested, <0.5 unmatched).

toolsPreview.name: confirm_reconciliation
toolsPreview.description: Apply confirmed reconciliation matches to Xero. Marks matched bank transactions as reconciled.

toolsPreview.name: categorise_expenses
toolsPreview.description: Suggest Portuguese tax categories for uncategorised Xero expenses. Returns category, VAT tier, deductibility, and VAT breakdown per transaction.

toolsPreview.name: apply_categories
toolsPreview.description: Apply confirmed Portuguese tax categories to Xero transactions. Updates AccountCode and TaxType.

toolsPreview.name: calculate_vat
toolsPreview.description: Calculate Portuguese VAT for a given amount, category, and region. Supports Mainland, Azores, and Madeira rates. Detects intra-community B2B reverse charge.

toolsPreview.name: draft_invoice
toolsPreview.description: Create a DRAFT invoice in Xero with VAT preview. Returns line totals and tax amounts for review before sending.

toolsPreview.name: send_invoice
toolsPreview.description: Authorise a DRAFT invoice and email it to the contact via Xero. Two-step: sets status to AUTHORISED then triggers email.

toolsPreview.name: generate_report
toolsPreview.description: Generate a financial report: P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow (indirect method from balance sheet deltas), or VAT Summary with Portuguese SAF-T filing hints.
